text.en: BLIP is row 29 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Multimodal area.
text.zh: BLIP 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 29 行，所属领域为“多模态”。

text.en: The annual table associates BLIP with “BLIP: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training for Unified Vision-Language Understanding and Generation”.
text.zh: 年度表把 BLIP 与论文《BLIP: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training for Unified Vision-Language Understanding and Generation》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Junnan Li, Steven Hoi”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Junnan Li（官方页拼写）、Steven Hoi（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Junnan Li, Steven Hoi”。
